title: Audio grew into a fuller toolkit
summary:
This week made more kinds of media possible through the API, while making models easier to find, connect, and use.

Whisper Large V3 and Scribe v2 added transcription choices, ElevenLabs music generation joined the audio API, and Eleven v3 became the default speech model. A new `/audio/models` endpoint exposes capabilities and pricing, while Play and API-key permissions now account for audio models.

Supplied dimensions now guide video sizing across Veo, Seedance, Wan, and Grok Video. Wan 2.6 gained text-to-video, image-to-video, and a backup provider route; Grok Video now passes reference images through. An API update also fixed reference-image editing and inpainting for GPT Image.

A setup guide and script added Pollinations as an OpenAI-compatible provider for OpenClaw. The guide gained separate paths for new and existing agents, web-search options, and a broader explanation of using 25+ Pollinations models. The integration joined the app catalog too.

GLM moved to version 5, `qwen-character` joined as an alpha roleplay model, and a paid-only `claude-legacy` ID added API access to Claude Opus 4.5. Claude routing became more explicit; hidden models stopped appearing in lists, while unstable or retired model routes were removed. Image-model defaults were adjusted for speed, quality, and aspect-ratio handling.
